  echo: false

resources:
  - README.md
  - requirements.txt

```{r}
#| label: rebuild-blog7
#| results: asis
# The RStudio entry point uses base R to launch Python; no Jupyter session is needed.
starts <- unique(c(getwd(), Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")))
starts <- starts[nzchar(starts)]
doc <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH")
if (nzchar(doc)) starts <- c(dirname(doc), starts)
candidates <- unique(unlist(lapply(starts, function(p) {
  c(p, file.path(p, "blog/posts/post7"), file.path(p, "posts/post7"), file.path(p, "post7"))
})))
valid <- vapply(candidates, function(p) file.exists(file.path(p, "code/run_all.py")), logical(1))
if (!any(valid)) stop("Cannot locate post7. Keep index.qmd with code/ and data/.")
post <- normalizePath(candidates[which(valid)[1]], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
python <- Sys.getenv("BLOG7_PYTHON")
if (!nzchar(python)) python <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PYTHON")
if (!nzchar(python)) {
  available <- Sys.which(c("python", "python3"))
  available <- available[nzchar(available)]
  if (!length(available)) stop("Python was not found. Set BLOG7_PYTHON to its executable; see README.md.")
  python <- unname(available[1])
}
dir.create(file.path(post, "result"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
log <- file.path(post, "result/rebuild_log.txt")
Sys.setenv(PYTHONUTF8 = "1", PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8")
status <- system2(python, args = c(shQuote(file.path(post, "code/run_all.py")), "--from-quarto"),
                  stdout = log, stderr = log)
if (status != 0) stop(paste(c("Blog7 analysis failed. See result/rebuild_log.txt.",
                             tail(readLines(log, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), 35)), collapse = "\n"))
article <- readLines(file.path(post, "result/_article_fragment.html"), warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
# A raw HTML block prevents Markdown from parsing Plotly JavaScript or inventing Divs.
cat("\n````{=html}\n", paste(article, collapse = "\n"), "\n````\n", sep = "")
```
